conditions.displayName: More than 2% of function calls failed (5xx) over 10 minutes, with at least 20 calls

documentation.subject: Roadside: functions failing
documentation.content:
Cloud Functions (2nd gen, asia-south1) return server errors on more than 2% of calls. Client errors (bad input, not allowed, rate limited) are 4xx and don't count.

Open Logs Explorer: `resource.type="cloud_run_revision" severity>=ERROR` to see which function. If a release just went out: docs/runbooks/rollback.md. If bookings are affected: docs/runbooks/dispatch-outage.md.
